h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madhyamgram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madhyamgram

items.pText: Madhyamgram, on the northern edge of Kolkata in North 24 Parganas, has seen a steady rise of apartment complexes over the last two decades. For a builder, the children's play area is one of the amenities buyers check at handover, and it has to be ready on time. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, roughly 1,650 km away, and delivers to the Kolkata region by road.

We work with developers from the planning stage. Share the amenity drawing, the area set aside for play and the expected age range of residents' children. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and once you approve it, we manufacture, dispatch and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A builder's checklist for the play area

items: Finalise the play area before landscaping, so the base, drainage and flooring are planned together.
Keep it away from driveways and the basement ramp, and fence it if it opens onto a road.
Ask for the layout drawing early and share it with your architect.
Plan seating for parents nearby, such as a bench from our

c: Kolkata's monsoon brings heavy rain and waterlogging, so set the play area slightly higher than the surrounding lawn. A compact multi play system from
photographs well for brochures and fits a modest podium or garden.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,650 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you work with our architect on a Madhyamgram project?
items.a: Yes. Share the amenity plan and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which your architect can fit into the garden plan.

items.q: How do we avoid waterlogging in the play area?
items.a: Raise the base slightly above the lawn, give it a drainage slope and lay rubber flooring. Plan this before landscaping starts.

items.q: Do you install in North 24 Parganas?
items.a: Yes. Equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory and is installed by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing.
